scope: Eight existing pending items plus one bounded official open-source candidate; source research only, not a runtime detection claim or exhaustive market inventory.
interpretation: BRAND in the existing pending catalog is an investigation category, not proof of an exact MC|Brand/minecraft:brand wire value.
No stable MOD/PACK/BRAND identity proven does not mean the product is harmless or undetectable by behavioral checks.
No reviewed source established an injection-only identity either; closed-source status does not prove a particular injection mechanism.
HTTP error-body hashes identify the retained response only. Browser-only observations have null content hashes; no raw page hash is invented.
Installer, framework, client-plugin, predecessor and embedded dependency identities/licenses are not inherited by a host client.
Evidence records versions explicitly advertised or declared by the pinned source; no local client/game or packet tests were performed.
